title: Hotbar Profiles
description: Tired of loading a kit and having to organize your inventory? Then this mod is for you!
body:
-- Default Keys --
Z - Next Profile
X (Hold) - Apply Profile
G - Save Hotbar as Profile
H - Delete Current Profile

-- Disclaimer --
Using this mod to restock w/out opening your inventory might get u banned by the ac of some pvp servers. So only use it for organizing your hotbar at the beggining of the duel!!

To change your profiles name you will have to edit the file hotbar-profiles.json at your config folder. In future updates I'll make sure you can edit it in game.

Have Fun :D
- MelenitazZ
